name: plugin.google_adk_runtime
description: Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) runtime orchestration, session tracking, checkpoint rewind, and dynamic skill registration engine.

entrypoints.name: adk_run_agent
entrypoints.description: Execute an ADK agent workflow on a user prompt with session state tracking and multi-turn memory

parameters.name: agent_name
parameters.description: Identifier of the target ADK agent (e.g. 'root_agent', 'research_agent')

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.description: User instruction or task input for the agent

parameters.name: session_id
parameters.description: Unique session identifier for state persistence

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Model identifier to bind to the ADK agent

entrypoints.name: adk_list_sessions
entrypoints.description: List active and historical ADK session states and metadata

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of sessions to return

entrypoints.name: adk_rewind_session
entrypoints.description: Rewind an ADK agent session to a previous event checkpoint

entrypoints.name: adk_register_skill
entrypoints.description: Register a dynamic capability skill or prompt pattern into the ADK runtime

parameters.name: skill_name
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the dynamic skill

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Semantic description of the skill capability

parameters.name: prompt_template
parameters.description: Prompt instructions or tool configuration for the skill
